finding: Public delivery is still slow and variable outside the origin server.
evidence: Twenty-five external requests from the audit location produced time-to-first-byte values from about 1.09 to 4.47 seconds, while the same routes took about 1.5 to 2 milliseconds on server loopback. DNS points directly to the Singapore origin at 47.84.65.103, and a compressed main-JavaScript download timed out after 20 seconds in this audit location.
impact: A slow first visit can reduce conversion, crawling efficiency, and perceived product quality. Target-market impact remains unconfirmed without US, UK, Canada, and Australia field data.
fix: Put only public HTML and fingerprinted assets behind a CDN, keep API/SSE/WebSocket paths uncached, and add regional synthetic plus real-user Core Web Vitals monitoring.
source: curl timing, server loopback timing, DNS

finding: Most indexable pages remain too shallow to compete for non-brand search intent.
evidence: Fourteen of 16 sitemap pages contain fewer than 400 parsed words. The four detailed feature pages contain 328 to 399 words, and the current site exposes only guide and interview-question hubs rather than deep editorial pages.
impact: The pages can now be indexed, but they provide limited topical depth and limited passage-level evidence for search engines and AI answer systems.
fix: Publish a small set of substantial, reviewed English feature and guide pages with distinct intent, real examples, update dates, and contextual internal links.

finding: The public site has policy pages but little firsthand product evidence or identifiable editorial authority.
evidence: All 16 initial HTML documents contain zero visible content images. No product screenshots, demo video, case study, verified testimonial, named author/reviewer, official social profile, or external source citation was found in the reviewed public surface.
impact: Visitors and AI/search systems have limited evidence that the product works as described or that informational guidance is maintained by identifiable experts.
fix: Add real product screenshots and a permission-safe demo, then publish named author/reviewer information and only verified user evidence or official profiles.
source: 16-page HTML crawl and public navigation review

finding: The Download page does not offer a download or a next-step action.
evidence: The `/download` page contains only navigation, policy, and email links; it has no installer link and no sign-in/start CTA despite explaining which installer a user should choose.
impact: High-intent visitors reach a dead end and cannot complete the expected download journey from the public page.
fix: Add verified macOS Apple-silicon, macOS Intel, and Windows installer actions when those artifacts are approved, or clearly route users to sign in to access the current release.

finding: Several commercial and policy metadata fields are shorter than the current quality targets.
evidence: Pricing, Privacy, Refund Policy, and Security titles are under 30 characters; Pricing and Contact meta descriptions are under 120 characters. No title exceeds 60 characters and all values remain unique.
impact: This is not an indexing blocker, but weak snippets can reduce query clarity and click-through rate.
fix: Rewrite only the short title and description fields with specific, accurate intent language while preserving the current canonicals and visible promises.

finding: Trailing-slash canonical redirects discard campaign query parameters.
evidence: `/features/?utm_source=test` redirects to `/features` and `/pricing/?x=1` redirects to `/pricing`, dropping the query string; canonical `www` and HTTP redirects preserve it.
impact: Marketing links that contain both a trailing slash and UTM parameters can lose attribution data before the landing page loads.
fix: Preserve `$is_args$args` on trailing-slash redirects or normalise campaign URLs before distribution, then regression-test UTM retention.

finding: The social share image is unnecessarily large.
evidence: `/assets/brand/share-card.png` is 772,542 bytes for a 1200 by 630 social-preview image.
impact: This can delay link-preview fetches and wastes bandwidth, although it does not block page rendering.
fix: Compress the share asset to an appropriately optimised PNG or supported social-preview format while retaining 1200 by 630 dimensions.

finding: Search and conversion performance cannot yet be evaluated from available data.
evidence: No Google Analytics, Search Console HTML verification, Bing verification, or equivalent public tag was detected. DNS-based verification and private analytics configuration were not available to this audit.
impact: The team cannot distinguish indexing delay, ranking weakness, acquisition quality, and conversion loss using the evidence currently available.
fix: Connect Search Console, Bing Webmaster Tools, and privacy-reviewed analytics or confirm existing DNS-based ownership and server-side measurement.
source: homepage source scan and access limitation
